system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You can provide custom instructions that are injected into the system prompt on every session.
system_prompt_style.note: The system prompt is assembled at runtime from per-phase directives generated from the role config plus AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files discovered by walking up from the working directory.

env_context_strategy.note: LSP navigation tools are also available. No up-front file tree injection is documented.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: This compresses command output (git, cargo, npm, docker, etc.) by 60-90%, reducing LLM context usage.
context_compaction.note: RTK rewrite is on by default (hooks.rtk-rewrite). The read tool also truncates output. The Pi SDK condenser was not visible in the bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The harness truncates intelligently, shows line numbers, can request
observation_format.note: Vision metadata exists for models, but no image observation path was seen in the bundle.

tool_call_format.note: The parser lives in the pi-mono SDK, which is not in the bundle.

tool_count.note: The full tool registry was not visible. Documented tools include read, bash, edit, write, grep, find, ls, the Agent tool, lsp_* tools, web_fetch, web_search and set_phase.

edit_primitive.note: The edit/write semantics are inferred from tool names only. lsp_rename is an opt-in AST-aware rename.

tool_schema_source.note: MCP support exists (see B5), but the schema source for the built-in tools was not visible.

protocol_standardization.note: Also: "mcp-adapter/ -- MCP server integration". The 'other' value is ACP.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: For each pipeline phase (plan, build, review, explore, research), the system prompt tells the orchestrator exactly what to do
loop_primitives.note: Ferment mode adds structured plan execution.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Ferment persists a structured plan (goal, phases, steps) as a JSON state file.
planning_granularity.note: Ferment is opt-in; the hierarchy is phases containing steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The orchestrator delegates each task to the model assigned for that role
multi_agent_topology.note: Default is the multi-model mode per the README role defaults. Single-model mode is also available.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The LLM can spawn specialized agents via the `Agent` tool — each runs as a focused child session

human_in_loop.note: Ferment manual continuation asks the user before advancing to the next phase.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Kimchi tags every LLM request with a `phase:{name}` label

long_term_memory.note: Skills are loaded from .kimchi/skills. Memory is opt-in per agent.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Rehydrates state, continues Phase 2 exactly where it left off

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Review is always delegated**, even when the orchestrator has the reviewer role, to ensure independence via a fresh context.
self_verification.note: The linters/typecheck value refers to LSP diagnostics synced on edits.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: escalates to heavy-tier only for complex work (concurrency, algorithms) or as a retry after a standard-tier model has failed
retry_policy.note: Model escalation on retry is prompt-driven, not a harness-level retry policy.

rollback.note: The edit tool implementation is in the pi SDK and was not visible in the bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: max_turns: <int> # Cap conversation turns; omit for unlimited (pi's 30-min hard cap still applies)

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the orchestrator picks the lightest-tier model that fits the task
cost_controls.note: Caching is not evidenced in the bundle. A budget-retry-guard file exists but was not inspected.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: kimchi gives you an AI-powered development assistant in your terminal
execution_isolation.note: Remote cloud sandbox is available via /teleport.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: kimchi gives you an AI-powered development assistant in your terminal

network_policy.evidence_quote: Kimchi respects `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` environment variables for network requests.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Users can add custom Bash hooks to rewrite or block shell commands before they run.
permission_model.note: The default policy is unclear; a permissions extension exists.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: run the [terminal-bench](https://www.harborframework.com/) suite (89 tasks) against kimchi inside Docker containers.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Users can add custom Bash hooks to rewrite or block shell commands before they run.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A coding agent CLI powered by [kimchi](https://kimchi.dev/).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Roles accept any `provider/model-id` string or an array of strings.

first_release_date.note: No tag history in the bundle.
